notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Update to fix some problems players were having!

- Now automatically switches to the dedicated graphics card over integrated - so if the game was running poorly on your gaming laptop, this could fix that
- Fixed a few problems with connecting to bad servers
- Fixed some start up crashes - and better logging for when start up crashes happen

Thanks!
- Lee

notes.title: Update 1.26 - Fixes
notes.content:
Update 1.26 is now live with some small fixes.

- Fixed error on joining all servers for some players
- Fixed error at ending tutorial after dying 1 or 2 times
- Added message telling players to join servers in their country or near them

Since we don't host our own servers, we are still dealing with some server issues. For more info on that check out this post:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/417890/discussions/0/494631967651501561/

Thanks!
- Lee
